The '''''Evuk-Nosk''''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] starship that brought the first of their kind to the planet [[Voss]] during distant times. After crashing on the planet, the ship became lost after a flood sank the ship deeper beneath the surface. In time, the ship became a legend and a dark omen to the native [[Voss (species)|Voss]] along with the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]].

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Halykus]] and the Voss discovered that a faction of Gormak were seeking the ''Evuk-Nosk''. These Gormak intended to recover the vessel and use it to scorch the skies of Voss and annihilate their enemies' stronghold of [[Voss-Ka]]. As the ship was being uncovered, its influence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] saw it visibly affect the Voss.

The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] tasked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] spacer with ending the Gormak recovery efforts.
